name: encoding.csv
doc:
CSV (RFC 4180) with Go's encoding/csv semantics: quoted fields with ""
escapes and embedded newlines, a custom delimiter, comment lines, lazy
quotes, leading-space trimming and a fixed or free field count; the
Writer quotes only what needs it. Read<T> / Write<T> map rows to structs
with compile-time reflection: a column per field, named by @csv(name:)
or the field name, or placed by @csv(index:); @csv(skip: true) and
@serde(name:, skip:) also apply.

items.doc: Formats records with the default options.

items.summary: Reads a header row and then one T per record (see the file comment).

items.name: ReadNoHeader
items.doc: Reads records without a header: field i (or @csv(index:)) is column i.
items.summary: Reads records without a header: field i (or @csv(index:)) is column i.

items.name: Write
items.summary: A header row and one record per row (see Read<T>); fields with @csv(index:) go to that column, the others fill the free columns in declaration order.
